tie_breakers: Strategy ID A then B then C if all preceding values tie
selection_rule.test_usage: Evaluate all three strategies after configurations are fixed; do not tune or reselect using test

split_rationale: 20 distinct gold pages; no dev/test gold-page overlap. Disjoint topics where practical, but shared report and related sections remain.
limitations: Small test set (5), one report, cross-lingual Vietnamese queries/English evidence.
Authoring assisted by Codex, evidence and answer review not independent; learner should review before retrieval runs.
Exact-evidence alternatives scanned across corpus; semantically equivalent alternatives may still exist. Record and accept verified equivalent evidence consistently across all strategies.
